top_signals.title: Oil Prices No Longer Follow Headlines
top_signals.summary: A month ago, a series of news reports said oil flows out of Hormuz had recovered to pre-war levels, pushing oil prices lower. However, the rout did not last. Benchmarks are set for their fourth monthly gain in a row, and no amount of repeating that Gulf states are exporting even more oil than before the war can change that. Because barrels are not the whole story. “What is the price of oil? Eight months into the war with Iran, what should be a straightforward question has become surprisingly hard to answer,” JP Morgan’s head…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Romania Is Offering Eurobonds After New Government Takes Office
top_signals.summary: Romania is selling bonds on the international market for the first time after the country approved a new government to overcome more than five months of political turmoil.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: DNV’s Insight: 53 New Orders for Alternative-Fueled Vessels in October
top_signals.summary: October maintained the strong pace of contracting for alternative-fueled vessels observed since the summer, with 53 new orders recorded during the month, according to DNV’s Alternative Fuels Insight (AFI) platform.LNG accounted for 30 of October’s orders.
